gates.name: Run the sample in both roles
gates.reason: build/Test-SampleRoundTrip.ps1 states in its own header comment that it is 'Linux-only, and it always was: it signals processes and reads the store with sqlite3', and P/Invokes DllImport("libc") for SIGTERM/SIGKILL. This session runs on Windows. The script was run: both the web and worker sample processes started and listened successfully (confirmed via their own logs), but the script itself produced no further output and made no progress for over 15 minutes (no worker-restart log ever appeared, consistent with the libc P/Invoke never resolving on Windows). It was terminated rather than left hanging. The corresponding CI check on the pull request (the 'build' job's 'Run the sample in both roles' step, on ubuntu-latest) is where the authoritative answer comes from. The same code path was verified manually instead: the operated sample was started directly, a valid bearer token authenticated and its principal id round-tripped into an audit column, and a forged token was refused with 401 CredentialRejected before reaching the endpoint (see PR #214 description).
